major_findings: RLUSD on XRPL is reported around $707.4M on November 1, down 30.21% over 30 days and 43.26% from its October 7 peak; Ethereum holds about $1.71B, or 71% of the two-chain total.
The Q3 Blockworks summary reported $1.01B XRPL RLUSD and $1.03B XRPL stablecoins; the current chain-specific balance implies about a 30% drawdown, but source and timestamp methods must be reconciled.
Bitquery found 99.6% of 30-day RLUSD payment count was dust from a 110-wallet cluster carrying only 7,722 RLUSD; this invalidates raw payment count as a broad-adoption feature.
The remaining 14,600 payments moved $7.33B gross, but the top ten senders represented 82%, issuer operations about 20%, and a $424M each-way loop added $848M gross; this is not net capital.
The cluster was funded through Binance-labelled PoR wallets, but evidence fits a customer using Binance rails and does not attribute conduct to Binance corporate.
The bot shutdown occurred near Cross River Bank's October 15 RLUSD announcement; causality is unknown.
XRP derivatives open-interest providers differ materially; keep provider series separate until contract and venue universes are normalized.
